build_provenance.policy: Reuse the hashed strength model and its original source manifest; record current Cup-generation code separately.

reason: AC40-informed scenario analysis; AC75 calibration unavailable

build_budget.randomization_policy: Shared seed and common initial Gaussian draws; later draw alignment can differ when simulated series lengths differ.

conditioning.ability: Team capability is drawn once and persists throughout the tournament; missing AC40 strengths receive a population prior.
conditioning.reliability: Conditional on completed, scored races; failures and timing stoppages are not sampled.
conditioning.scenario_weights: Finite sensitivity grid with no probability weights; its envelope is not a confidence interval.
conditioning.transfer: Rho is an assumed loading on AC40 effects, not a fitted cross-class correlation. No AC75 calibration is established.
conditioning.weather: All team weather-response slopes are zero unless explicitly supplied in the rules; no AC75 weather response is fitted.

mapping_provenance.policy: Arithmetic mean of observed AC40 entry effects within each team; unobserved teams retain a population prior.

model_lineage.selection_policy: Explicit pinned chronological strength model; source outcomes on/after its training-before-day are excluded.
